title: Chapter 175: Multi-Service Joint Operations
content:
Chapter 175: Multi-Service Joint Operations

The Zerg Hydralisks quickly cleared the evil eyes near the underground world barrier, and 100,000 Zerg puppies swarmed down from the platform and entered the underground world.

The evil eyes finally found the enemy that appeared out of thin air, and launched an attack on the Zerg puppies that were rushing towards them. Dense red scorching rays shot on the Zerg puppies, making a sizzling sound.

The terrain of the underground world ghoul territory is flat. The body of the evil eye, plus the tentacles under it, is only more than one meter high, and the height of the Zerg puppies is more than two meters. In this way, the Zerg puppies charging in the front completely blocked the shooting range of the evil eyes for the Zerg behind.

No matter how many evil eyes there are, their attack method is scorching rays, which is a straight line shooting. When they gather together, the number that can attack at the same time is limited.

There are wise men in the ghoul clan and the evil eye clan. They know the weaknesses of the evil eyes. In the evil eye group, giant ghouls are also deployed.

The giant ghouls began to spray corrosive mucus at the Zerg puppies that rushed into their range. Under the dual attack of corrosive mucus and the burning rays of the evil eye, the Zerg puppies began to suffer casualties.

The Zerg puppies rushed forward regardless of casualties, despite the burning rays of the evil eye and the corrosive mucus attacks of the giant ghouls. The 30,000 Zerg Hydralisks followed closely and entered the underground world, spraying a large amount of Zerg biodegradation liquid at the distant evil eye group.

In particular, the biodegradation liquid sprayed by the one-star hydralisk sprayed far above the evil eye group and exploded violently. The dense Zerg biodegradation liquid splashed on the evil eye like raindrops, corroding the life of the evil eye at a speed visible to the naked eye.

With the long-range suppression of the Zerg Hydralisks, the pressure on the Zerg puppies charging in front was greatly reduced, and they rushed into the dense evil eye group at once.

The evil eye, which can only whip with thin tentacles in close combat, encountered the Zerg puppies, which were top masters in close combat, and it was a one-sided massacre!

The Zerg puppy's blade arm slashed through, and the evil eye was like an ordinary meat ball, with its body and tentacles cut off and instantly turned into light and disappeared.

Seeing that the Zerg puppy was no match for the close combat, many evil eyes launched scorching rays at a very close distance.

The Zerg puppy was flexible and experienced in combat, and could easily predict and avoid such close-range scorching rays. Instead, the scorching rays shot randomly killed and injured many evil eyes.

When the Zerg puppy rushed into the evil eye group, the Zerg Hydralisk followed closely and launched a fierce attack, disrupting the evil eye's position. At this time, 10,000 Zerg flying dragons flew into the underground world at high speed and attacked the dense area of evil eyes on the ground!

The dense biological bomb explosion affected most of the evil eye gathering areas. The scattered evil eyes counterattacked the flying dragons in the air, and the giant ghouls, which were obviously more in number than yesterday, also attacked the flying dragons in the air.

The Zerg dragons in the air use their extremely fast flying speed and flexible flying skills to dodge various attacks while launching counterattacks on the ground attack area.

The limited giant ghouls' attacks cannot hit the Zerg dragons. The attacks of the evil eyes can hit the Zerg dragons, but the power is insufficient and it is difficult to cause fatal damage.

The Zerg dragons in the air will only choose to withdraw from the battlefield, evacuate the underground world, and return to the Zerg territory to recover from injuries when they are about to be unable to support themselves after being attacked by the evil eyes many times.

The flying soldiers of the Zerg cannot drill into the ground, but landing on the Zerg fungal carpet can speed up the recovery of injuries.

Under the tacit joint attack of the three arms of the Zerg puppies, hydralisks and dragons, the evil eye army in the evil eye gathering place formed in the ghoul territory in one night suffered heavy losses.

Wu Qing discovered that as long as the Zerg puppies rushed to the side of the evil eye, they would be the nemesis of the evil eye, and their killing efficiency was very high. He then began to hatch Zerg puppies in the Zerg territory and continuously sent reinforcements, preparing to fight a war of attrition with the two races found in the underground world.

After the Zerg puppies were upgraded, even if the ghouls were on the field, they would still not be the opponents of the Zerg puppies.

As long as the ghouls did not continue to request external aid, and only had the current arms, Wu Qing was ready to use the Zerg puppies to cooperate with the various Zerg arms to fight a technically demanding war of attrition with the ghouls.

The Zerg is now charging with puppies in the front, and has successfully killed into the group of evil eyes and slaughtered them. The evil eyes and giant ghouls have limited damage to them, and there are not too many casualties.

The Zerg Hydralisks are in the safest position, with puppies blocking them in front, and the small evil eyes can hardly attack them, and the giant ghouls can't reach them because of their position.

They can calmly launch attacks and provide long-range support for the Zerg puppies.

The most dangerous ones are the Zerg dragons. They fly in the air and easily enter the attack range of the evil eye. The laser-like burning light keeps flying around, and you will be hit if you are not careful.

The giant ghouls are also constantly launching powerful corrosive mucus attacks into the air. This attack is slow and easy to dodge, but when their number reaches a certain level, the corrosive mucus flying in the air will increase, which will still compress the flight space of the Zerg dragons.

There are constantly injured Zerg dragons flying away from the battlefield quickly, leaving the underground world and going to the Zerg territory to recover from their injuries.

Although the Zerg dragons will have casualties such as quitting the battle midway, their number of nearly 10,000, and the attacks launched from the air are very terrifying, setting off a terrifying explosion wherever they pass!

Energy shocks, corrosive attacks of Zerg biological decomposition fluids, tracking explosion attacks of miniature biological bombs flying around, etc., can kill and injure all enemies in the explosion area, and a large number of them will disappear in light.

Even if the enemy was lucky enough to be injured but not killed in such an explosion, they would die quickly under the rapid corrosion and melting of the Zerg biological decomposition fluid.

It would not take long for the Zerg dragons to pass through the place where nothing was left.

The Zerg dragons took the risk of bombarding the gathering area of the evil eyes. After paying the price of nearly a thousand dragons leaving the field, they successfully blew up at least hundreds of thousands of evil eye troops, giving all the Zerg puppies the opportunity to rush into the gathering area of the evil eyes.

The Zerg puppies began to fight the evil eyes in full-scale close combat. The Zerg dragons flew to the gathering area of the ghouls and the skeleton blood pool of the ghouls' nests, continuing the unfinished task yesterday and striking the ghouls with the greatest force.

After the expansion of the Zerg territory, it was not far from the underground world. The Zerg puppies who came to help quickly rushed into the underground world and joined the battlefield.

The Zerg Hydralisk followed the Zerg Zergling's attack rhythm and began to move forward, continuing to spray Zerg biodegradation liquid at the distant enemies and Zerg Zerglings.

300 stealth spiders crawled over, scattered everywhere, followed the Zerg Zerglings, and found positions to drill into the ground. The evil eye, which had been hit multiple times, now had to face more attacks from the ground spikes that could be stabbed out at any time.

One hit from the ground spikes could kill the evil eye.

The angry evil eye began to release burning rays desperately regardless of anything. Such random attacks caused a lot of damage to the Zerg Zerglings, but the damage to the evil eye itself was greater than that of the Zerg Zerglings.

The ghoul sage and the giant evil eye, who were in charge of commanding the battle from a distance, realized that the evil eye alone was no match for the Zerg, so they sent the ghouls on standby around to the battlefield.

Although the ghouls have been attacked by the Zerg dragons, the number of ghouls in this ghoul territory is really endless. There are less than 10,000 Zerg dragons, and they can't kill too many all day long.

The skeleton blood pool in the nearby area has been damaged to a certain extent, but it is not easy for the dragons to completely destroy the skeleton blood pool, which is a waste of time.

The dense skeleton blood pools in the ghoul territory are constantly hatching ghouls. In the farther places, I don't know how many such skeleton blood pools there are.

If the Zerg did not defend a small area near the underground world barrier and could retreat at any time, but ran to the middle of the ghoul territory, in ground combat, all the existing Zerg forces would be invested, and it would not be enough for the ghouls.

The Zerg three-star host followed the dragon group to fly to the area near the middle of the ghoul territory and detected more information. In terms of military strength, the number of ghouls in this ghoul territory should be calculated in billions!

Through the tip of the iceberg of the ghoul territory, we can see how huge and boundless this underground world is!

Wu Qing didn't know where the ghouls found these evil eyes in such a short time. According to the detection of the three-star host, no other races were found in this ghoul territory.

The ten queens of the Zerg, all hidden in the flying dragon group, have released reconnaissance parasites on those ghoul wise men and the giant evil eyes. The Zerg should be able to obtain a lot of useful information by following them.

The underground world is mysterious and unpredictable. If you can't figure out some things, don't think about them first. Now the Zerg still regards destroying the enemy and obtaining resources as its primary goal.

On the battlefield, the ghouls mixed into the evil eyes, which greatly increased the pressure on the Zerg puppies. Although the combat power of the ghouls is not as good as that of the current Zerg puppies, compared with the evil eyes, they still have the strength to fight. The two sides are no longer a one-sided massacre.

The old rivals of the Zerg puppies and ghouls fought again on the battlefield.

The ghouls are still the same ghouls, but the Zerg Zerglings have become different. Once they start fighting, it is obvious that the ghouls cannot beat the Zerg Zerglings.

The Zerg Zerglings that continue to join the battlefield, with the long-range support of the Zerg Hydralisk, fight against the combination of ghouls and evil eyes.

The long-range support of the Zerg Hydralisk can continuously spray the Zerg biodegradation liquid, making the enemy bathed in the terrible biodegradation liquid and fighting hard, and let the Zerg Zerglings be covered with the terrifying liquid, making it easier to defeat the enemy.

The evil eyes have almost no support for the frontal combat of the ghouls. Their size and scorching light are not suitable for providing support to the ghouls in such an environment.

The evil eyes mixed in the ghouls can only play the role of threatening the Zerg flying dragons in the air, preventing the Zerg flying dragons from attacking the ghouls in battle recklessly.
